description: Source code implementing Playready license management for DRM, including license creation, license update, challenge generation, and HDCP requirement checking.

classes.name: PlayreadyLicense
classes.description: Implements DRM license handling for PlayReady, including license creation, challenge generation, license updating, and HDCP requirement checking.

methods.name: PlayreadyLicense
methods.description: Constructor initializing license with provided data, generating challenge if valid.

methods.description: Updates license with new license data, possibly re-creating trust input and challenge.

methods.description: Checks if HDCP is required for output protection.
